patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with distinct background colors (dark green, light green, off-white) are used to clearly delineate major content blocks, with content centered within a consistent max-width container.

A strong typographic hierarchy is established with oversized, bold sans-serif headings for hero and major section titles, complemented by smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif labels for contextual information.

The primary palette revolves around a sophisticated range of greens (dark, light, vibrant accent) contrasted with deep charcoal for text and clean off-white/light grey for backgrounds and card surfaces.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport across all scroll depths, ensuring persistent access to site navigation and branding.
The hero section features a dynamic, subtly animated background of shifting green gradients and abstract shapes, creating a sense of depth and modern technology.
Content is frequently presented in asymmetrical layouts, pairing large images or video embeds with adjacent text blocks or card grids, creating visual interest and dynamic balance.

technique_notes: A persistent, sticky navigation bar maintains brand presence and access to key actions throughout the user's scroll journey.

The hero section features a generative background animation, likely implemented with a canvas, that creates a subtle, shifting gradient of greens and abstract shapes, providing a dynamic yet non-distracting visual foundation.

Scroll-triggered animations, managed by a library like Locomotive Scroll, progressively reveal content sections and individual cards with a smooth fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing content discovery and visual flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (hero ~4-5x body) with clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif labels for context. Body text is legible and well-spaced.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and input fields, but main content blocks and cards generally maintain sharp corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a professional and breathable layout.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dynamic, subtly animated green gradient background in the hero, combined with a sophisticated, smooth scrolling experience, elevates it beyond a standard corporate site. This creates an immersive and modern feel that subtly reinforces the 'deep tech' aspect of their brand.
